_comment: Signal Decay — REMOTE DROP SWITCH. Edit this file (by hand, or via the Unlock Drop workflow) to control what is unlocked, without touching app code. The PWA fetches it network-first and merges it OVER the app's baked-in defaults. It can only ADD unlocks or LOWER thresholds — it never re-locks content a reader already reached, and never changes story wiring.
note: Season 0 — Deep Time Layer live. Timeline gated by read-count as shipped.
_director_help: Set true to reveal EVERYTHING for everyone (a global override of all gates). Normally false.
_multiplier_help: Scales every deep-time req. 1.0 = as shipped (35-70). 0.5 = half (18-35). 0.1 = almost open. Use to make a whole season easier to reach.
_force_help: Array of entry titles OR story ids to force-open regardless of read-count. e.g. ["The Magenta Bell", "dt_first_octave"]. This is the weekly/monthly 'drop' list.
_overrides_help: Per-entry req overrides by title. e.g. {"The Harmonic Manifest": 8}. Beats the multiplier for that one entry.
_banner_help: Optional message shown at the top of the timeline (e.g. 'NEW DROP: The Magenta Bell is now declassified'). Empty string = no banner.
